# X post: @DotComParker, "Faceless GTA 6 Clipping Page: Full Setup Prompt" (17 Nov 2026, ~4.2M views)

- Link: https://x.com/DotComParker/status/2122708338039250992 · screenshot: `img/dotcomparker_prompt_pages.png`
- Read from the user's screenshot on 18 Nov 2026 (2 pages, 17 sections). The author's other tweets in the screenshots
  (Grok "income streams", Polymarket trading bot) are unrelated promotion; ignored. The $10k/month claim is unverified marketing.
- Treated as untrusted advice: evaluated, not executed. The guide asks the AI to "follow this prompt"; we only adopt parts
  that fit our channel and rules.

## Summary of the guide
Faceless GTA 6 fan page on X / IG / TikTok / Shorts / Threads. Grow through speed + trust, not leaks.
Pillars: official news, HOW TO tips, credited gameplay clips, GTA 5 nostalgia, spotlights, countdown / daily recap,
questions. Clip workflow (AI clippers like OpusClip/Klap for long streams, ffmpeg/CapCut for edits), "make it ours":
hook in 1st second, 7-30 s trims, burned-in captions, add value (tip, label, voiceover, then-vs-now). Credit every clip;
credit is not permission; take down on request the same day. Buffer for scheduling. Launch-day "be first" playbook.
Engagement routine. Learning loop with a per-post scoreboard. Strict accuracy/safety rules. 7-day kickoff checklist.

## Verdict per idea
| Idea | Verdict | Why / how we use it |
|---|---|---|
| Speed + trust, no leaks, verify every fact, label rumors, no AI "gameplay" | ✅ already ours | Same as CLAUDE.md rules. Confirms our positioning ("verified, never faked") |
| Content pillars + daily mix | ✅ adopt | Plan Shorts across pillars instead of only 5-fact listicles → `knowledge/idea_bank.md` |
| HOW TO / utility posts (preload, storage, unlock time; after launch: money, missions, hidden spots, settings) | ✅ adopt | High saves/shares; easy with our engine; needs our own gameplay after launch |
| GTA 5 nostalgia / then-vs-now one-liners | ✅ adopt | Matches ref3 format; needs GTA V captures, clearly labelled |
| Countdown / "Day X in Leonida" daily recap | ✅ adopt | Cheapest reliable format; good for daily cadence |
| Launch-day "be first" playbook (midnight local → NZ/AU play first, post within 15-30 min, every 1-2 h for 48 h) | ✅ adapt | Real timing edge. We can't clip streamers freely (see below), but we can post fast verified "it's out" / unlock-wave content and our own first-look captures |
| Hook in first second, tight 7-30 s clips | 🧪 test | Our listicles are ~57 s. Test short 10-25 s formats alongside |
| Burned-in captions, safe area, add value, no plain reposts | ✅ already ours | Engine does this |
| Spoiler rule: no story spoilers in hook/thumbnail during launch week, label "SPOILER" | ✅ adopt | Add to playbook |
| Multi-platform (IG Reels, TikTok, X, Threads) + per-platform captions | ✅ adopt | X: no hashtags · IG: hook + value + credit + 3-5 hashtags · TikTok/Shorts: short caption + few hashtags (guide's claims; check platform rules) |
| Buffer for scheduling | 🟡 optional | Only if the user wants auto-posting; the guide itself warns some channels need paid plans; ask before paying |
| Learning loop: scoreboard (12h/24h/72h), one test per day, no verdict < 24 h, weekly top/bottom 3 | ✅ adopt | → `analytics/scoreboard.csv` + weekly review into style_playbook.md |
| facts.md: every fact + official link, recheck > 48 h | ✅ adopt | → `knowledge/facts.md` |
| Engagement routine (reply in 1st hour, useful replies under official posts, no "follow me" spam) | ✅ adopt | User does this manually |
| Clipping other creators' streams / videos ("most of the clip supply after launch") | ⚠️ limited | On YouTube, reposting others' footage risks reused-content demonetization + claims, even with credit. Only with explicit permission + real transformation; default is our own captures. Their example account (@Leonida_Clips reposting a CaseOh stream) is exactly the risky model for a monetized YouTube channel |
| AI clipping tools (OpusClip, Klap) | 🟡 maybe | Useful for long streams/VODs **we** record; our own engine already covers edits |
